run_lit_test_suite: run lit to execute LLVM style test suites and summarize results
discover_test_suites: discover test suites by finding lit.cfg.py config files in directory trees
execute_parallel_tests: execute tests in parallel using multiprocessing pool with configurable job count
generate_xunit_output: generate xunit XML output file from test run results for CI integration
execute_shell_tests: execute shell-style test files with command pipelines and output assertions
